description.content:
Diagnostic Robotics API Document

This document describing the API of patient-questionnaire service.

High level description of the flow:
 1. create a patient
 2. create a visit for the patient
 3. select questionnaire for the visit
 4. get first (or next) question
 5. answer the question
 6. repeat 4-5 until answered all questions
 7. finalize the visit
 8. get visit outcome - triage results

API key should be included in all requests.
